$comment: Vditor compat lock — see media-src/check-vditor-compat.js for the semantics. When intentionally bumping vditor, update `expectedVersion` AND `expectedDistJsHash` AND retest.

$apiSurface.$comment: Vditor APIs the fork actually uses. Audited at C1.12 (vditor 3.11.2 bump). If any of these disappears in a future vditor release, the bundle won't build (TypeScript) AND the integration smoke fails. Listed here for grep-ability when reviewing future bumps.
$apiSurface.constructor: new Vditor('app', { lang, cdn, value, mode, cache, toolbar, toolbarConfig, ..., after, input, upload })

cdn_loader.$comment: vditor reads window.__vditorCdn (passed as `cdn` option) and builds asset URLs as ${cdn}/dist/js/lute/lute.min.js, ${cdn}/dist/js/i18n/<lang>.js, etc.
